orientation: inside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: the core sits on the floor with its top 4px overhanging the inner wall face (see offset); cable plugs into the power coupling
notes: Grundl Hauler Thrusters, a hull mount (outward is up): two enormous steel bells with rows of big rivets and amber stencil bands, bolted to a heavy riveted base and flanked by strapped fuel cells with chains; the exhaust is a thick orange roar. Inside a core with a rack of three fuel cells (amber labels, valves), a big gear and a ribbed manifold. Damaged: the left bell has a split seam and sputters, a fuel-cell strap snapped and the cell sags, the chain hangs, sparks at the coupling. Disabled: the left bell broken off, the right bent over, the cells fallen, the core dark. THIS FILE: the INSIDE half (core, power coupling, repair hatch; its top 4px overhang the inner wall face as a flange).
